{{Quote|Thanks for meeting me. Here are some important findings from the Ministry of Science in Theed. I'm getting back to town before something else jumps me.|Bor Ting|<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Bor Ting''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked as a courier on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] he was sent to [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]] to deliver a [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]] to [[Damalia Korde]] that contained information about the [[Berserker Virus]]. When a creature surprised him on his way, he took a minor leg injury. Korde sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to find Ting and bring the datadisc to her.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ScientistNPCTemplate.png|250px|thumb|All possible depictions of Bor Ting]]
Bor Ting was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Bor Ting spawned under the generic "scientist" template, his appearance was randomized under one of twelve possible depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Bor Ting could appear as included [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], and [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] of either [[Gender/Legends|gender]], a male [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], and a female [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]]. The [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Bor Ting as male, however the [[canon]]ical species cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
